items.heading: File and bootstrap
items.wording: Single self-contained HTML file; no external subresource of any kind is requested on load.

items.heading: File and bootstrap
items.wording: `<title>` is `Kusto Query Lifecycle: Two-Level Interactive Walkthrough`; `<html lang="en">`.

items.heading: File and bootstrap
items.wording: The script runs under `"use strict"` and requires no `DOMContentLoaded` guard.

items.heading: File and bootstrap
items.wording: Bootstrap executes exactly `initializePassTable(); render();`.

items.heading: File and bootstrap
items.wording: After bootstrap, `.pass-lab` is a direct child of `.center` positioned immediately before `.step-detail`. **[C]** — it is authored inside `#optimization-additional-context`.

items.heading: File and bootstrap
items.wording: Each of the 22 optimization table rows has class `pass-row`, `data-pass-index`, a 4th cell, and a click handler that ignores clicks landing inside an `<a>`.

items.heading: Stage level
items.wording: Exactly 10 stage buttons, in the order Syntax, Semantic, Relop, Preparation, Initial optimize, Partial queries, Final optimize, Physical plan, Serialize, Execute.

items.heading: Stage level
items.wording: `#journey-progress` reads `Stage N of 10`.

items.heading: Stage level
items.wording: The selected stage shows amber border and inverted number badge; visited-not-selected stages show a green `✓`.

items.heading: Stage level
items.wording: Stage 1 shows a `✓` on first load without any interaction. **[C]**

items.heading: Stage level
items.wording: `#previous-stage` is disabled at stage 1; `#next-stage` at stage 10.

items.heading: Stage level
items.wording: Selecting a stage resets `stepIndex` to 0, resets all lab state, stops both timers, and sets `traversalIndex = focuses[0]`.

items.heading: Stage level
items.wording: Selecting a stage does **not** preserve scroll position. **[C]**

items.heading: Substep level
items.wording: Substep counts per stage are exactly 4, 5, 4, 4, 5, 4, 5, 5, 3, 6 (45 total).

items.heading: Substep level
items.wording: Each substep chip shows `Substep N`, the title, a cyan walk badge, an amber change badge, and a runner badge chosen by the precedence pass → physical → compiler → boundary → execution.

items.heading: Substep level
items.wording: The four runner-less substeps (S4.1, S4.4, S6.1, S6.2) show **no** runner badge and render **no** lab section and **no** placeholder.

items.heading: Substep level
items.wording: Each substep chip carries a source-link anchor labelled `{file}:{line}–{end} ↗`.

items.heading: Substep level
items.wording: `#step-slider` `max` equals `steps.length - 1` and tracks `stepIndex` bidirectionally.

items.heading: Substep level
items.wording: Selecting a substep preserves scroll position across the layout change (synchronous restore plus one `requestAnimationFrame` restore).

items.heading: Substep level
items.wording: `#step-summary` and `#step-action` display the identical string. **[C]**

items.wording: At S5.1 exactly 5 of the 22 passes are marked `CHANGES THIS TREE`.

items.heading: Runner engines
items.wording: Physical lab is visible at exactly `7-0…7-3` with 5, 8, 7, 7 actions and the four mode pills.

items.heading: Runner engines

items.heading: Runner engines
items.wording: The boundary plan explorer offers 6 nodes with NodeIds 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, **6** and three views (`C# object`, `JSON`, `UTF-8 bytes`); the hex view wraps at 16 bytes and truncates at 192. **[C]** — the NodeId gap is intentional.

items.heading: Runner engines
items.wording: The boundary quiz accepts `Plan` / `Context` / `Both` and marks only `Context` correct.

items.heading: Runner engines
items.wording: The boundary context experiment recomputes only the context buffer size; the plan buffer size is constant and `PLAN REBUILT?` always reads `No`.

items.heading: Runner engines
items.wording: Execution lab is visible at exactly `9-0…9-5` with 7, 7, 7, 8, 8, 7 events and 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4 scenarios.

items.heading: Runner engines
items.wording: Execution heap folds `add` / `update` / `release` events over four zones in the fixed order managed, borrowed, cpp, rust, with `live` / `mutated` / `released` styling.

items.heading: Runner engines
items.wording: The execution heap reflects the **selected** event index, not the executed one. **[C]**

items.heading: Gating
items.wording: Pass, compiler, and physical Apply buttons are enabled only when the selected index equals `applied + 1`; labels cycle `Applied ✓` / `Apply … {n}` / `Apply … {k} first`.

items.heading: Gating
items.wording: The execution Execute button is **never** disabled and applies via `Math.max`. **[C]**

items.heading: Gating
items.wording: Applying never changes any displayed tree, state pane, or heap contents — only chip classes, badges, counters, and button labels. **[C]**

items.heading: Gating
items.wording: Every rail's prev/next buttons are disabled at their respective bounds.

items.heading: Gating
items.wording: Every index is clamped into range on render, so no out-of-range state can produce an exception.

items.heading: Traversal
items.wording: The traversal mode pill, summary, movement, and unwind text come from `traversalCatalog[stageIndex]`.

items.heading: Traversal
items.wording: Four shared trees are used: `languageTree` (stages 1–3), `relopTree` (4–8), `physicalTree` (9), `executionTree` (10).

items.heading: Traversal
items.wording: Every id in every `order` exists in its tree, and every tree node appears in its `order`.

items.heading: Traversal
items.wording: Node classes resolve as `current` / `returning` / `visited` per the occurrence arithmetic in §5.8.

items.heading: Traversal
items.wording: `data-order` shows the first occurrence ordinal, replaced by `✓` once visited. **[C]**

items.heading: Traversal
items.wording: Clicking a node seeks to the next occurrence at or after the current index, else the first.

items.heading: Traversal
items.wording: Play advances at 850 ms, stops at the end, and rewinds to 0 if pressed at the end.

items.heading: Traversal
items.wording: Entering S2.5 clamps `traversalIndex` from the out-of-range `focuses[4] = 18` to 17. **[C]**

items.heading: Source links
items.wording: All links target `msazure.visualstudio.com/One/_git/Azure-Kusto-Service` pinned to `version=GCe6fd1fd059015c2db443ae044b72f3dfba2d3cf3`.

items.heading: Source links
items.wording: Labels render as `{file}:{line}–{end} ↗` with an en dash, collapsing to `{file}:{line} ↗` when start equals end.

items.heading: Source links
items.wording: All 45 `preciseLinks` entries are distinct.

items.heading: Source links
items.wording: Every call-path method resolves in `methodTargets`; every traversal node id resolves in `treeNodeReferences`.

items.heading: Source links
items.wording: `S4.4`'s `PassManager.Execute` link resolves to `Common/PassManager.cs:58–88`. **[C]**

items.heading: Source links
items.wording: Tree linkification uses a longest-key-first alternation with `(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])` / `(?![A-Za-z0-9_])` boundaries.

items.heading: Source links
items.wording: Prose linkification skips text inside `a`, `button`, `code`, `pre`, `script`, `style`, and is idempotent across repeated renders.

items.heading: Source links
items.wording: All outbound anchors use `target="_blank"`; 7 boundary-lab anchors use `rel="noreferrer"` while the rest use `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. **[C]**

items.heading: Keyboard and accessibility

items.heading: Keyboard and accessibility
items.wording: No `role`, `tabindex`, `aria-selected`, or `aria-current` attributes exist anywhere. **[C]**
